_comment: Hand-written Flow staging for the launch-set clips (Daniel, Oct 4): start position, setting, camera view and hold per slug. Used by scripts/build-launch-sheet.py to write docs/media-redo-launch.json. Settings: st = standing, ch = seated on a plain armless chair or bench, mat = on an exercise mat on the floor, mc = using the machine.
arm_circles: Stands tall with feet hip-width apart and both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
assisted_pull_up_machine: Kneels on the pad of the assisted pull-up machine, gripping the high handles with straight arms.
bal_seated_head_turns: Sits tall near the front of the chair, away from the backrest, feet flat, hands resting on the thighs, looking straight ahead.
band_chest_fly: Stands tall with a long band anchored behind at chest height, one handle in each hand, arms open wide to the sides and elbows softly bent.
band_lat_pulldown: Stands tall facing a post with a long band anchored high above, one end in each hand, arms reaching up.
band_overhead_press: Sits tall on the chair with the middle of a long band under both feet, holding the ends at shoulder height, palms forward.
band_pull_apart: Stands tall holding a long band in both hands at chest height, arms straight in front, hands shoulder-width apart.
barbell_hip_thrust: Sits on the floor with the upper back resting against the long side of a flat bench, knees bent, feet flat, a padded barbell across the hips.
box_breathing: Sits tall on the chair, feet flat, one hand on the chest and one on the belly, eyes softly closed.
bridge_floor_press: Lies on the back on the mat, knees bent, feet flat, hips lifted into a bridge, a dumbbell in each hand with elbows on the floor beside the chest.
brisk_walk: Stands tall mid-stride, one foot forward, arms bent at 90 degrees and swinging.
cable_chest_fly: Stands in a staggered stance in the middle of a cable station, handles at shoulder height, arms open wide with soft elbows.
cable_pallof_press: Stands side-on to a cable station, feet hip-width, both hands holding the handle against the middle of the chest at chest height.
cable_woodchop: Stands side-on to a cable station with feet wide, both hands on the handle up high beside the shoulder nearest the pulley.
cat_cow: Kneels on hands and knees on the mat, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat.
cw_arm_swing_walk: Walks at a relaxed pace, arms hanging loose and swinging gently.
cw_easy_bike: Sits upright on an exercise bike, hands on the handlebars, feet on the pedals.
cw_seated_ankle_pumps: Sits tall on the chair with both legs straight out in front, heels resting on the floor.
doorway_chest_stretch: Stands in a doorway with one forearm upright against the frame, elbow at shoulder height, one foot a step forward.
dumbbell_dead_bug: Lies on the back on the mat holding one light dumbbell with both hands above the chest, knees bent at 90 degrees over the hips.
dumbbell_floor_fly: Lies on the back on the mat, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand pressed up over the chest, elbows softly bent.
dumbbell_romanian_deadlift: Stands tall with feet hip-width, knees soft, a dumbbell in each hand resting against the front of the thighs.
dumbbell_seated_calf_raise: Sits tall on the chair, feet flat, a dumbbell resting upright on each thigh just above the knee.
dumbbell_shoulder_press: Sits tall on the bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward, elbows under the wrists.
dumbbell_split_squat: Stands in a long split stance, one foot forward and the back heel lifted, a dumbbell hanging in each hand at the sides.
dumbbell_suitcase_carry: Stands tall holding one dumbbell at the side in one hand, the other arm relaxed, ready to walk.
dumbbell_sumo_squat: Stands with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell vertically by the top end between the legs.
fc_bike_intervals: Sits upright on an exercise bike, hands on the handlebars, pedalling.
fc_fast_march: Stands tall with one knee lifted to hip height and the opposite arm bent forward.
fc_low_impact_jacks: Stands tall with feet together and arms down by the sides.
fc_seated_fast_march: Sits tall near the front of the chair, feet flat, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
fc_seated_jacks: Sits tall near the front of the chair, feet together, arms down by the sides.
goblet_squat: Stands with feet shoulder-width, holding one dumbbell vertically against the chest with both hands.
hip_abduction_machine: Sits tall in the hip abduction machine, back against the pad, knees together with the pads on the outside of the knees.
hip_adduction_machine: Sits tall in the hip adduction machine, back against the pad, knees open with the pads on the inside of the knees.
hip_circles: Stands with feet hip-width, hands on the hips, knees soft.
incline_machine_press: Sits in the incline chest press machine, back against the pad, hands on the handles at upper-chest height.
jumping_jacks: Stands tall with feet together and arms down by the sides.
lat_pulldown: Sits at the lat pulldown station, thighs under the pads, arms straight up holding the wide bar.
leg_press: Sits in the leg press machine, back against the pad, feet hip-width on the platform, knees bent.
leg_swings: Stands side-on to a wall with one hand on it, the outside leg lifted just off the floor.
machine_ab_crunch: Sits tall in the ab crunch machine, feet under the rollers, hands on the handles by the shoulders.
machine_chest_fly: Sits tall in the pec deck machine, back against the pad, arms open to the sides holding the handles at chest height.
machine_leg_extension: Sits in the leg extension machine, back against the seat, knees bent, the pad resting on the lower shins.
overhead_triceps_stretch: Stands tall with one arm raised, elbow bent so the hand rests behind the head, the other hand on that elbow.
prone_lat_pulldown: Lies face down on the mat, forehead just off the floor, arms reaching overhead just off the floor.
push_up: Holds a high plank on the mat, hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
reverse_lunge: Stands tall with feet hip-width and hands on the hips.
seated_band_pulldown: Sits tall on the bench holding a long band overhead with straight arms, hands wide apart.
seated_calf_raise_machine: Sits in the seated calf raise machine, pad on the thighs, balls of the feet on the step, heels low.
seated_figure_four_stretch: Sits tall on the chair with one ankle crossed over the other knee, hands resting on the shin.
seated_hamstring_stretch: Sits near the front of the chair with one leg straight, heel on the floor, the other foot flat, hands on the thighs.
seated_leg_curl_machine: Sits in the seated leg curl machine, legs straight, the lower pad above the heels and the thigh pad snug.
sf_seated_prayer_press_pulses: Sits tall on the chair, palms pressed together in front of the chest, elbows out to the sides.
side_plank: Lies on one side on the mat, propped on the forearm with the elbow under the shoulder, legs stacked, hips lifted in a straight line.
single_arm_band_incline_press: Stands in a staggered stance with a long band anchored low behind, one handle at the shoulder in one hand.
single_arm_bridge_floor_press: Lies on the back on the mat in a hip bridge, one dumbbell in one hand with the elbow on the floor beside the chest.
single_arm_cable_pulldown: Sits on a bench below a high cable pulley, one arm reaching up holding a single handle.
single_arm_high_to_low_band_fly: Stands side-on to a long band anchored high, holding the handle in the near hand with the arm raised out to the side.
single_arm_high_to_low_cable_fly: Stands side-on to a high cable pulley, holding the handle in the near hand with the arm raised out to the side.
single_leg_glute_bridge: Lies on the back on the mat, one foot flat with the knee bent, the other leg straight up toward the ceiling, arms on the floor.
sl_seated_band_leg_back_pull: Sits near the front edge of the chair with a long band looped around both ankles, feet flat.
sl_seated_double_leg_extension: Sits tall on the chair, hands holding the sides of the seat, knees bent, feet flat.
sl_seated_hand_pressed_heel_raise: Sits tall on the chair with both hands pressing down on top of one knee, that foot flat on the floor.
sl_seated_seat_hover_hold: Sits near the front of the chair with feet under the knees, leaning forward with the chest over the knees.
st_neck_diagonal_stretch: Sits tall on the chair, one hand resting on the thigh, the head turned slightly to one side and chin lowered toward that armpit.
st_seated_calf_stretch: Sits near the front edge of the chair with one leg straight, heel on the floor and toes pulled back.
st_seated_forward_fold: Sits on the chair with feet wide, hands on the thighs, back long.
st_seated_hip_flexor_stretch: Sits sideways on the edge of the chair, the outside leg slid back with the knee pointing down and toes on the floor.
st_seated_wide_leg_stretch: Sits on the chair with knees wide, hands on the inner thighs, back long.
st_wall_front_shoulder_stretch: Stands side-on to a wall with the near palm flat on the wall behind at shoulder height, arm straight.
st_wall_lat_stretch: Stands an arm's length from a wall with both hands flat on it at shoulder height.
standing_quad_stretch: Stands tall with one hand on a wall, the other hand holding the same-side ankle with the heel near the glute.
step_up: Stands facing a flat bench with one foot flat on top of it, the other on the floor.
su_seated_band_overhead_pulldown: Sits tall on the chair holding a long band overhead with straight arms, hands shoulder-width.
su_seated_shrug_hold: Stands tall with feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at the sides, shoulders down and loose.
su_seated_w_pulldown: Sits tall on the chair with both arms reaching straight up overhead, palms forward.
superman: Lies face down on the mat, arms straight overhead and legs straight, forehead resting on the floor.
supported_hip_extension: Stands facing the back of a chair with both hands on it, standing tall on both feet.
supported_single_leg_rdl: Stands beside a chair with one hand on its back, weight on the near leg with a soft knee.
sv_cs_arms_up_arch: Sits tall on the chair with fingers interlaced overhead, arms straight.
sv_cs_hands_behind_head_chest: Sits tall on the chair with hands resting lightly behind the head, elbows open wide.
sv_cs_palms_up_overhead: Sits tall on the chair with fingers interlaced and palms turned up toward the ceiling, arms straight.
sv_cs_side_lean_lat: Sits tall on the chair with one hand behind the head and that elbow pointing up.
sv_cs_side_sit_quad: Sits sideways on the chair with one hand on the backrest, the outer leg bent back beside the seat.
sv_mo_chair_cat_cow: Sits tall near the front of the chair, feet flat, hands on the knees.
sv_mo_crossed_arm_rotations: Sits tall on the chair with arms crossed on the chest, knees pointing forward.
sv_seated_backrest_chest_opener: Sits tall on the chair, both hands holding the sides of the backrest behind.
sv_seated_hands_on_knees_lift: Sits tall near the front of the chair, feet flat, hands on the knees.
towel_lat_pulldown: Sits tall on the chair holding a towel overhead with both hands, arms straight, towel pulled tight.
wide_incline_push_up: Leans on a sturdy table with hands a little wider than the shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
wu_ankle_rocks: Stands facing a wall with both hands on it, one foot forward a hand's length from the wall.
wu_arm_hug_swings: Stands tall with feet hip-width, arms open wide to the sides at chest height.
wu_hip_gate_openers: Stands tall with one hand on a chair, the other hand on the hip.
wu_inchworm_lite: Stands tall with feet hip-width, knees soft, hands by the sides.
wu_lateral_leg_swings: Stands facing a wall with both hands on it, one leg lifted just off the floor.
wu_mini_squats: Stands behind a chair with both hands on its back, feet hip-width.
wu_seated_elbow_openers: Sits tall on the chair with fingertips on the shoulders and elbows pointing forward.
wu_seated_knee_extensions: Sits tall on the chair, knees bent at 90 degrees, feet flat.
wu_seated_knee_lifts: Sits tall at the front of the chair, feet flat, hands on the sides of the seat.
wu_seated_reach_ups: Sits tall on the chair, feet flat, hands resting on the thighs.
wu_seated_shoulder_rolls: Sits tall on the chair, arms relaxed by the sides.
wu_seated_side_bends: Sits tall on the chair with feet flat and arms hanging by the sides.
wu_step_jacks: Stands tall with feet together and arms down by the sides.
band_external_rotation: Stands side-on to a long band anchored at elbow height on the far side, the elbow of the near arm against the body bent at 90 degrees, hand in front of the belly holding the band.
band_external_rotation_90: Stands facing a long band anchored in front, upper arm raised out to shoulder height, elbow bent at 90 degrees, hand pointing forward holding the band.
band_internal_rotation: Stands side-on to a long band anchored at elbow height on the same side, elbow against the body bent at 90 degrees, hand out to the side holding the band.
band_row: Stands tall facing a long band anchored at chest height, one handle in each hand, arms straight in front.
kneeling_thumbs_up_raise: Kneels with one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, back flat, the other arm hanging down holding a light dumbbell, thumb forward.
dumbbell_kickback: Stands bent forward from the hips with one hand and the same-side knee resting on a flat bench, the other hand holding a light dumbbell, upper arm along the side and elbow bent at 90 degrees.
pendulum_swing: Leans forward with the good hand on a table, the other arm hanging straight down, loose and relaxed.
prone_horizontal_abduction: Lies face down on a flat bench, the arm on one side hanging straight down toward the floor holding a light dumbbell.
prone_scapula_setting: Lies face down on the mat with the forehead on a small folded towel, arms straight by the sides, palms up.
prone_table_scapular_retraction: Lies face down on a flat bench, the arm on one side hanging straight down off the edge holding a light dumbbell, elbow straight.
rx_side_lying_er: Lies on one side on the mat, head on the bottom arm, the top elbow bent at 90 degrees resting on a small towel on the hip, a light dumbbell in front of the belly.
side_lying_internal_rotation: Lies on one side on the mat, head on a small pillow, the bottom elbow by the side bent at 90 degrees with a light dumbbell, forearm resting out in front.
sleeper_stretch: Lies on one side on the mat, head on a small pillow, the bottom arm in front with the elbow bent at 90 degrees and the hand pointing up, the top hand on that forearm.
stick_external_rotation_stretch: Stands tall with one elbow against the side bent at 90 degrees, holding one end of a light stick, the other hand holding the far end in front of the belly.
stick_internal_rotation_stretch: Stands tall holding a light stick horizontally behind the back at hip height with both hands.
supine_shoulder_rotation_90: Lies on the back on the mat, one upper arm out at shoulder height on the floor, elbow bent at 90 degrees, fingers pointing up holding a light dumbbell.
